entities.summary: Shlomo "Sami" Turgeman is a Major General in the IDF reserves and is a former commander of the IDF Southern Command. His other past posts include: commander of the Israeli Ground Forces, head of the Armored Corps and head of the Operations Division of the Operations Directorate. He was previously commander of the Pillar of Fire Reserves Formation in the Northern Command.
